about: TF's sound events (src/generated/resources/assets/twilightforest/sounds.json at 9e40a757), generated by tools/sounds/baseline/generate.ps1: do not edit. Per event: the owning unit, the Bedrock category of the SoundSource TF plays it with (tools/sounds/categories.json), TF's subtitle key and TF's variants flattened through event references (volume and pitch multiplied, stream if either streams; a vanilla event counts the Bedrock sounds it maps to in tools/sounds/vanilla.json). tools/sounds/synth.ps1 fails when a rendered definition differs. Derived from The Twilight Forest 4.8 (TeamTwilight/twilightforest @ 9e40a757): src/generated/resources/assets/twilightforest/sounds.json (event ids, subtitle keys, volume, pitch, stream); src/main/java/twilightforest/** (the SoundSource of the call sites and entity classes: the categories).
